## Judged

- **judged-evidence-e2e-file-refs** [accepted-deviation]: The spec's evidence citations point at the wrong e2e files: AC-1 cites "e2e 31's 'story and spike are offered exactly where the server accepts them'" and AC-2/AC-3 cite "e2e 32's" graduation/refusal journeys, but all four named tests (offered-exactly, story-sticky→coverage-yarn→graduation, zero-yarn refusal, illegal-pair refusal) live in e2e/tests/30-board-scoping-canvas.spec.ts — both today and at the spec's frozen commit 42ccf1e. e2e 31 is board-stub-instantiate and e2e 32 is board-scoping-yarn (projection/drag/trash journeys); neither contains the cited specs. The behaviors themselves are implemented and tested, so every AC holds semantically, but a reader chasing the declared evidence lands in the wrong files. (confidence 0.85) — Accepted as citation errata in a frozen spec, corrected here (the R4-I-83 designed channel: the deviation record travels with the archive). Verified ground truth: all four cited behaviors — the story/spike picker placement, the story-sticky→coverage-yarn→graduation journey, the zero-yarn refusal, and the illegal-pair refusal — live in e2e/tests/30-board-scoping-canvas.spec.ts, not the e2e 31/32 files the AC prose names. The drafting error is the spec author's (the retro-decomposition pass mapped test names to file numbers from a boundary-less grep); the behaviors themselves are implemented, tested, and evidenced — only the prose anchor is wrong. The living verdi.bindings.yaml comments inherited the same mis-mapping and are being corrected in the in-flight fix branch.
